newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank-Steady repo has short-term crown effect.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank-Steady repo has short-term crown effect.

text.p: The fact that Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, has not lowered its key interest rate, the repo, since December 17 has only had a short-term effect on the crown, the bank said on Thursday.
The bank's deputy governor Lars Heikensten was asked if the absence of repo rate cuts had added to the crown's weakness.
"In that case, it is only a short-term effect," Heikensten told a news conference.
He said money market players who had taken positions ahead of continued rate cuts are turning these around.
The repo rate was cut 25 times last year to its current level of 4.10 percent from 8.91 percent but has not been lowered since December.
Meanwhile the crown has softened by over six percent since October and on Thursday midday was trading at 4.5410 to the mark. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017
